# Bachpan Global

> India's leading preschool chain with 1100+ schools offering play-based early childhood education through SPROUT Curriculum across multiple states.

Bachpan Global operates the largest network of play schools and preschools in India and Nepal, serving children from Playgroup through Upper Kindergarten (UKG). The organization combines proprietary teaching materials (Speak-O-Kit, SILK Kit) with child-centered pedagogy and offers both franchise opportunities and direct school enrollment.

## Core Platform & Programs

- [Bachpan Global Homepage](https://www.bachpanglobal.com): India's leading preschool chain with 1100+ schools offering comprehensive early childhood education
- [About Bachpan Play School](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/about-us.php): Organization overview: 1100+ schools across India and Nepal with vision for quality preschool education
- [SPROUT Curriculum](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/sprout-curicullum.php): Child-centered curriculum approach designed for holistic growth and developmental milestones
- [Playgroup Program](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/playgroup.php): Playgroup program with SPROUT Curriculum and Speak-O-Kit teaching materials for foundational learning
- [Nursery Program](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/nursery.php): Nursery curriculum using SPROUT and SILK kit teaching materials for cognitive development
- [Lower Kindergarten (LKG)](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/lkg.php): LKG program with play-based SPROUT Curriculum building foundational academic skills
- [Upper Kindergarten (UKG)](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/ukg.php): UKG program preparing children for school transition with enhanced academic readiness
- [Management Team](https://www.bachpanglobal.com/management.php): Visionary leadership driving Bachpan Global's innovation and pan-India expansion
